scope: Read-only-derived candidate specification; no runtime changes or simulated results.
recommendation: Separate construction, technical commissioning and administrative acceptance; explicit commission_project action.
source_namespace: S02/S03 refer to research/case_cards_202209_awards_20260909/case_cards.json, not policy_mapping sources with the same IDs.

construction.built_at: last required construction task completion round; immutable

physical.effective_at: boundary after successful commission_project settlement, before next external shock
physical.assessment: project-specific commissioning assessment preserves whether this intervention matched; do not test not root_repaired again at administrative acceptance

administrative.accepted_at: owner acceptance action settlement; no physical transition

orthogonal.paused: blocks future construction/commission actions; does not undo effective physical state
orthogonal.cancelled_at: terminates future tasks, no refunds or rollback
orthogonal.actor_knowledge: own actions and delivered lawful records only; physical ground truth remains audit-only

transitions.old: two construction tasks set physical_ready_round only
transitions.proposed: set construction=built and built_at; remain not_commissioned
transitions.legal_knowledge: assigned task and received prerequisite completion evidence
transitions.objective_conditions: both real construction tasks completed for this revision
transitions.messages: own completion records; ordinary explicit reports or activated shared delivery
transitions.failure: missing receipt or resources rejects action; no phantom work

transitions.old: accept_project conflates physical assessment and administrative acceptance
transitions.proposed: commission_project executes a synthetic technical flushing/testing/switching package; no new role
transitions.actor_basis: recommended synthetic responsibility; not a claim about case-law or reported exact operator
transitions.assignment: At budget approval create the same commissioning task definition inside the environment for both modes, with both construction tasks as prerequisites. Global creation grants no observation, assignment or authorization to role2. Ordinary delivery uses the existing construction-assignment channel with commissioning responsibility included in its package; structured delivery may aggregate that package through its existing lawful channel. Role2 can see and execute only after lawful assignment and prerequisite evidence delivery. No new request action or role; no policy-label access to hidden progress.
transitions.legal_knowledge: own assignment, current authorization and both received construction receipts; no hidden cause supplied
transitions.objective_conditions: both construction tasks really complete, current round >= last completion round + existing project_lag, project not paused/cancelled; engineering matches actual shared defect

resources.technical_labor: move old project_accept_cost=0.5 from owner4 to role2; provisional synthetic reallocation
resources.decision_labor: existing 0.1 per action retained; one extra administrative action means +0.1 decision labor relative to old full chain
resources.qualification: zero added capital/crew is a minimal abstraction, not an empirical estimate; do not claim total burden unchanged

transitions.messages: commissioning_result to performer; owner learns only through a lawful delivered record, whether ordinary reporting, activated structured synchronization, or zero-friction passive sharing. Lack of a manual report does not imply lack of knowledge. Preserve each channel's existing timing, costs and eligibility, including immediate zero-friction sharing.
transitions.failure: wrong engineering consumes attempted technical labor but never changes root risk; resource/receipt failures do not count as physical mismatch; no automatic retries

transitions.old: owner gets construction receipts, pays0.5, changes root_repaired and terminates project
transitions.proposed: accept_project confirms a delivered successful commissioning result plus existing review/budget/construction documentation; administrative state only
transitions.legal_knowledge: lawfully received records only; no inspection of private physical flag
transitions.objective_conditions: valid project-specific successful commissioning record; source identity/revision consistent
transitions.messages: administrative_acceptance record follows normal delivery rules
transitions.failure: missing evidence => business rejection/awaiting_evidence, not physical failure; no invented independent administrative-failure probability

transitions.old: terminate_project cancelled pending tasks and no refund
transitions.proposed: preserve termination of future tasks and no refund; never revert built/effective history or physical repair
transitions.legal_knowledge: existing recorded cancellation basis; no hidden defect oracle
transitions.objective_conditions: before commissioning cancels remaining commission task; after effective only closes administrative workflow
transitions.resources: existing decision cost and sunk costs retained
transitions.messages: pause/cancel records delivered normally; task menus follow received state
transitions.failure: decommissioning/removal not modeled; would require explicit new action/physical mechanism

invariants: Ordinary and structured projects use identical construction, commissioning, matching, resources and timing conditions; B does not alter project rules.
Built is necessary but insufficient for physical effectiveness; administrative acceptance is not necessary for physical effectiveness.
Administrative accepted implies prior successful physical commissioning; administrative cancelled may coexist with effective.
Wrong plans cannot become effective merely because professionals approved or documents were complete.
Commission result must preserve project-specific matching; root_repaired already true after success must not cause later administrative failure.
No message is delivered retroactively; actual effect and lawful actor knowledge may differ.
Existing unresolved local damage remains open; only its own required case work resolves it. Effective root repair changes future eligible recurrence risk, not old episodes.
Apply physical effect at a fixed settlement boundary before the next external shock; no retroactive risk edits.
Existing lag is a provisional readiness interval before commissioning; do not also add the same lag after commissioning.
No clinical/engineering calibration claimed; dates in reports do not calibrate synthetic rounds.
An active administrative project blocks duplicate same-topic commissioning; after termination use existing cooldown and audit duplicate attempts rather than hidden-state candidate filtering.

acceptance_cases.objective_vs_known: No observer is told effective; engineering remains built.

acceptance_cases.trigger: actor2 commission_project succeeds; inspect after its successful settlement and physical-effect boundary, before owner4 receives the result through any lawful channel; no other lawful delivery has occurred
acceptance_cases.objective_vs_known: In this conventional nonzero-friction case the environment lowers next eligible shock risk and actor2 holds the result, while owner4 has received none by the inspected time. This expectation does not apply after activated shared delivery or zero-friction passive sharing; those channels must update owner knowledge when their lawful delivery occurs.

acceptance_cases.trigger: owner attempts acceptance; later receives record and tries again
acceptance_cases.objective_vs_known: Missing lawful knowledge blocks administrative acceptance only.
Performer receives technical failure result, other roles only upon delivery.
Other actors keep old view until receipt; attempted stale action rejects without physical work.
Cancellation cannot undo operating infrastructure; no hidden rollback.

acceptance_cases.trigger: same commission action and fixed shock draw
acceptance_cases.objective_vs_known: Service only changes how evidence became available, not the physical gate.

acceptance_cases.trigger: next shock and later lawful local task completion

expected.future_risk: repaired risk after old issue resolved

acceptance_cases.objective_vs_known: Actor knowledge of repair does not select environment risk.
Do not reveal hidden matching through candidate filtering.
Readiness is derived from legitimate task receipts; actual gate agrees.
Administrative verification uses the project result, not a fresh not-root_repaired predicate.

open_decisions.question: Use role2 as technical commissioning actor?
open_decisions.default_recommendation: Yes, synthetic responsibility within existing four roles; owner4 remains organizer.

open_decisions.question: Accept minimal cost transfer and readiness timing?
open_decisions.default_recommendation: Transfer old0.5 technical labor to role2; owner acceptance only existing0.1 decision cost; retain readiness lag2 as uncalibrated assumption; disclose extra decision action and changed labor bearer.

open_decisions.question: Keep source repair separate from existing local-damage resolution?
open_decisions.default_recommendation: Yes for minimal revision; explicitly acknowledge this is a task abstraction and case report does not establish it for every household.
